record.bible_text: And Moses<WH04872> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto the heads<WH07218> of the tribes<WH04294> concerning the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, This <FI>is<Fi> the thing<WH01697> which the LORD<WH03068> hath commanded<WH06680><WTH8765>.

If a man<WH0376> vow<WH05087><WTH8799> a vow<WH05088> unto the LORD<WH03068>, or swear<WH07650><WTH8736> an oath<WH07621> to bind<WH0631><WTH8800> his soul<WH05315> with a bond<WH0632>; he shall not break<WH02490><WTH8686> his word<WH01697>, he shall do<WH06213><WTH8799> according to all that proceedeth<WH03318><WTH8802> out of his mouth<WH06310>. <RF>break: Heb. profane<Rf><CM>

If a woman<WH0802> also vow<WH05087><WTH8799> a vow<WH05088> unto the LORD<WH03068>, and bind<WH0631><WTH8804> herself by a bond<WH0632>, <FI>being<Fi> in her father's<WH01> house<WH01004> in her youth<WH05271>;

And her father<WH01> hear<WH08085><WTH8804> her vow<WH05088>, and her bond<WH0632> wherewith she hath bound<WH0631><WTH8804> her soul<WH05315>, and her father<WH01> shall hold his peace<WH02790><WTH8689> at her: then all her vows<WH05088> shall stand<WH06965><WTH8804>, and every bond<WH0632> wherewith she hath bound<WH0631><WTH8804> her soul<WH05315> shall stand<WH06965><WTH8799>.

But if her father<WH01> disallow<WH05106><WTH8689> her in the day<WH03117> that he heareth<WH08085><WTH8800>; not any of her vows<WH05088>, or of her bonds<WH0632> wherewith she hath bound<WH0631><WTH8804> her soul<WH05315>, shall stand<WH06965><WTH8799>: and the LORD<WH03068> shall forgive<WH05545><WTH8799> her, because her father<WH01> disallowed<WH05106><WTH8689> her.

And if she had at all an husband<WH0376>, when she vowed<WH05088>, or uttered<WH04008> ought out of her lips<WH08193>, wherewith she bound<WH0631><WTH8804> her soul<WH05315>; <RF>she vowed: Heb. her vows were upon her<Rf>

And her husband<WH0376> heard<WH08085><WTH8804> <FI>it,<Fi> and held his peace<WH02790><WTH8689> at her in the day<WH03117> that he heard<WH08085><WTH8800> <FI>it<Fi> : then her vows<WH05088> shall stand<WH06965><WTH8804>, and her bonds<WH0632> wherewith she bound<WH0631><WTH8804> her soul<WH05315> shall stand<WH06965><WTH8799>.

But if her husband<WH0376> disallowed<WH05106><WTH8686> her on the day<WH03117> that he heard<WH08085><WTH8800> <FI>it<Fi> ; then he shall make her vow which she vowed<WH05088>, and that which she uttered<WH04008> with her lips<WH08193>, wherewith she bound<WH0631><WTH8804> her soul<WH05315>, of none effect<WH06565><WTH8689>: and the LORD<WH03068> shall forgive<WH05545><WTH8799> her.
But every vow<WH05088> of a widow<WH0490>, and of her that is divorced<WH01644><WTH8803>, wherewith they have bound<WH0631><WTH8804> their souls<WH05315>, shall stand<WH06965><WTH8799> against her.
And if she vowed<WH05087><WTH8804> in her husband's<WH0376> house<WH01004>, or bound<WH0631><WTH8804> her soul<WH05315> by a bond<WH0632> with an oath<WH07621>;

And her husband<WH0376> heard<WH08085><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> , and held his peace<WH02790><WTH8689> at her, <FI>and<Fi> disallowed<WH05106><WTH8689> her not: then all her vows<WH05088> shall stand<WH06965><WTH8799>, and every bond<WH0632> wherewith she bound<WH0631><WTH8804> her soul<WH05315> shall stand<WH06965><WTH8804>.

But if her husband<WH0376> hath utterly<WH06565><WTH8687> made them void<WH06565><WTH8686> on the day<WH03117> he heard<WH08085><WTH8800> <FI>them; then<Fi> whatsoever proceeded<WH04161> out of her lips<WH08193> concerning her vows<WH05088>, or concerning the bond<WH0632> of her soul<WH05315>, shall not stand<WH06965><WTH8799>: her husband<WH0376> hath made them void<WH06565><WTH8689>; and the LORD<WH03068> shall forgive<WH05545><WTH8799> her.

Every vow<WH05088>, and every binding<WH0632> oath<WH07621> to afflict<WH06031><WTH8763> the soul<WH05315>, her husband<WH0376> may establish<WH06965><WTH8686> it, or her husband<WH0376> may make it void<WH06565><WTH8686>.

But if her husband<WH0376> altogether<WH02790><WTH8687> hold his peace<WH02790><WTH8686> at her from day<WH03117> to day<WH03117>; then he establisheth<WH06965><WTH8689> all her vows<WH05088>, or all her bonds<WH0632>, which <FI>are<Fi> upon her: he confirmeth<WH06965><WTH8689> them, because he held his peace<WH02790><WTH8689> at her in the day<WH03117> that he heard<WH08085><WTH8800> <FI>them<Fi> .

But if he shall any ways<WH06565><WTH8687> make them void<WH06565><WTH8686> after<WH0310> that he hath heard<WH08085><WTH8800> <FI>them<Fi> ; then he shall bear<WH05375><WTH8804> her iniquity<WH05771>.

These <FI>are<Fi> the statutes<WH02706>, which the LORD<WH03068> commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> Moses<WH04872>, between a man<WH0376> and his wife<WH0802>, between the father<WH01> and his daughter<WH01323>, <FI>being yet<Fi> in her youth<WH05271> in her father's<WH01> house<WH01004>.<CM>
